subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Perceber diálogos em textos narrativos, observando o efeito de sentido de verbos de enunciação e, se for o caso, o uso de variedades linguísticas no discurso direto.

components.description_pt: Identificar diálogos dentro de textos narrativos
Explicar efeito semântico de verbos de relato usados para introduzir discurso direto
components.description_en: Explain the semantic effect of reporting verbs used to introduce direct speech
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effect of a specific structural decision on the reader's experience of the text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer uso de variedades linguísticas em discurso direto dentro de textos narrativos
components.description_en: Recognize the use of linguistic varieties in direct speech within narrative texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify when a context or task requires the use of formal English

cc_matches.description: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, demonstrating command of formal English when indicated or appropriate.

Analyze how an author's choices concerning how to structure a text, order events within it (e.g., parallel plots), and manipulate time (e.g., pacing, flashbacks) create such effects as mystery, tension, or surprise.
